title: Mini F1B Goldendoodles (Posie)
temperament: Exceptionally intelligent, playful, hypoallergenic-friendly, sweet, and loves to cuddle.
cardDesc: Meet Posie and Torque's beautiful litter of Mini F1b Goldendoodles, where sweet personalities and cozy, low-shedding coats come together! These playful, well-loved little pups are eager to bring endless joy, wagging tails, and warm cuddles to your home.
